signals.summary: Supabase announced $150M in new funding led by GIC, with CapitalG, IronArc and Square Peg also participating. It came four months after the $500M Series F, and part of it gives employees liquidity.
Supabase is acquiring Turso, the SQLite-based database company, to build databases for AI agents. Turso founder Glauber Costa becomes Head of Agentic Services, and Turso stays open source.
Turso founders Glauber Costa (Head of Agentic Services) and Pekka Enberg are joining Supabase, and Costa will lead the agentic infrastructure effort.

At Supabase Select, the company announced 'Supabase from code' so coding agents can define and deploy the backend from the app repo. It also announced app-specific MCP servers and long-running services on Supabase Compute.

Supabase became a prebuilt connector in Google Cloud's Gemini Enterprise. The blog post is dated 9 Sep 2026 in the Turso post's navigation, while the product blog index appears to show 2 Oct, so the date is uncertain.
Supabase says it now adds more than 1M users and 4M databases per month, and 70% of new databases are created by agents or AI tools. It reports more than 13M developers on the platform.

Supabase has about 24 open remote roles on one job board. They include an AWS Partner Marketing Manager, a FinOps Engineer and an APAC-based Executive Assistant to the CEO, which points to scaling and an AWS channel push.

answer.notes: Funding and acquisition are confirmed by the press release, Supabase's own blog and Yahoo Finance. The $500M Series F at a $10.5B post-money valuation (June 2026, led by GIC) is just outside the 90-day window, so I left it out of the signals. Sources disagree on its exact date (Tracxn shows May 13 and Jun 4). The Gemini Enterprise post date is ambiguous (Sep 9 vs Oct 2). The hiring signal comes from a job-board aggregator with no date. I found no layoffs, earnings or other C-suite changes. The Feb 2026 incident post is older than 90 days. Conversation hooks: agent-driven database growth, enterprise MCP auth, the AWS and Google Cloud partner motion, and Turso integration.
